title: Firmware update
intro: Select a MCUboot firmware binary (.bin) from your computer. Use a file intended for the connected device.
bleUnsupported: Bluetooth updates require Web Bluetooth on HTTPS or localhost, or the desktop app.
usbUnsupported: USB recovery requires Web Serial on HTTPS or localhost, or the desktop app.
recoveryHelp: Enter serial recovery mode following the device's instructions, then select its USB serial port. Recovery can overwrite the running firmware. Keep USB connected until the upload finishes.
recoveryReady: The device is in serial recovery mode.
connecting: Choose the device or port and grant access when prompted.
ready: Choose a firmware file and connect to begin.
paused: Upload paused. Reconnect if needed, then resume with the same file and device.
uploaded: Firmware uploaded. Test and restart to try the new version.
awaitingReconnect: Restart requested. Wait for the device to start, then reconnect to check the running firmware.
unconfirmed: The selected firmware is running but is not confirmed. Check that the device works correctly before confirming. An unconfirmed test image may revert on the next restart.
complete: Firmware update complete. The selected version is running and confirmed.
recovered: Firmware written. Restart the device to leave recovery, then check that it starts correctly.
recoveryRestarted: Restart requested. Check that the device starts correctly; recovery upload does not verify application health.
reverted: The previous firmware is running again. The selected update was not activated or was rolled back.
unknown: The selected firmware is not running. Check the device and refresh its firmware status.
invalidFile: Select a valid MCUboot .bin file, up to 64 MiB. HEX files and archives are not supported.
unsupportedImage: This firmware image format is not supported. Select an unencrypted, uncompressed MCUboot binary with a SHA-256 image hash.
hashMismatch: The firmware file failed its integrity check. Obtain a fresh copy of the file.
uploadStalled: The device did not advance the upload. Reconnect and try again.
uploadMismatch: The device did not report the expected firmware image or state. Check its status before continuing.
unconfirmedImage: The currently running firmware is not confirmed. Complete its test and confirmation before uploading another image.
protocol: The device returned an invalid MCUmgr response.
timeout: The device did not respond in time. Reconnect to check its status or resume the upload.
endTaskHelp: This stops tracking the update and releases the connection for other tasks. Firmware already written to the device is kept; an unconfirmed test image may revert on a later restart.
